_meta.purpose: Canonical inventory of every internal Walmart endpoint SparkFraud touches or has documented. Replaces the inline URL constants in extension/*.js and the prose tables in notes/api_endpoints.md.
_meta.regenerable_from: recon/_capture.py (PROPOSED — passive observer of natural SPA traffic)

endpoints.name: dispatcher_trips
endpoints.purpose: Primary fraud-investigation endpoint. Trip list with assigned Spark driver + orders, filterable by store/time/service-type.
endpoints.response_shape_summary: payload.tasksByClientId['0'].{tripDisplayStatusMap, trips[]}; each trip has {storeId, batchId?, carrier, displayTripStatus, transitStatus, customerStartTime, customerEndTime, driver{firstName,lastName,driverUserId,contact.phoneNumber,...}, orders[{orderId, dropNumber, status, externalStatus, taskEvents?[]}]}
endpoints.pagination: pageSize:200 in body; no offset/cursor observed — paging mechanism unknown (notes/tools/dispatcher_mfe.md:218 TODO)
fixture_candidates: dispatcher_today_v2.json (needs sanitization before promotion to extension/fixtures/)

endpoints.name: dispatcher_counts
endpoints.purpose: Same filter shape as trips, returns status-count map only. Faster for tab-count refreshes.

endpoints.name: dispatcher_attention
endpoints.purpose: Counts of trips requiring attention. Default 7-day window.

endpoints.name: oms_orders
endpoints.purpose: Per-order item lookup. Returns 87-field rows; one row per item (NOT per order).
endpoints.realmid: varies (different from DISPATCHER_WEB_UI — let SPA set it)
endpoints.response_shape_summary: {status, header, payload: [<row>{orderNo, itemId, itemName, upc/wupc/sku, quantity, unitPrice, lineStatus, customerFirstName, customerEmail, shipToAddress, ...}]}
endpoints.response_size_caveat: Observed: 9 orders ≈ 365KB, 21 orders ≈ >1MB (truncated at 1MB cap before 2026-05-22 fix). capture.js now allows ≥10MB (extension/capture.js). Above ~50 orders single-call risks exceeding 10MB. OMS-PAGINATION-01 (2026-05-22) chunks app.js:fetchOrderItems requests into batches of OMS_BATCH_SIZE (default 10) to stay well under cap. Reduce OMS_BATCH_SIZE if single-order responses ever exceed ~1MB.
endpoints.pagination_caveat: Endpoint accepts limit/offset query params (we hardcode limit=200&offset=0). For SparkFraud, batching is done client-side: split orderIds into chunks of OMS_BATCH_SIZE and fire N separate requests with comma-separated subsets. Each batch is a separate driveOrderResolution call sharing the fast-path cached headers.
endpoints.header_totalCount_caveat: header.headerAttributes.totalCount is ORDER count, not ROW count (notes/api_endpoints.md:92)

endpoints.name: walmart_consumer_item
endpoints.purpose: Scrape og:image meta tag for product thumbnails. Walmart asset URLs are NOT derivable from itemId/UPC/WUPC.
endpoints.response_shape_summary: Consumer product HTML; we extract <meta property="og:image" content="...">
caveats: Some itemIds have no og:image (internal items like 'BAG'). Negative cache with shorter TTL.
Each lookup ~500ms — cache aggressively. 7-day TTL in chrome.storage.local.
endpoints.anti_pattern: DO NOT probe i5.walmartimages.com URL patterns — 11 patterns × 6 items × 6 origins all 404 (notes/api_endpoints.md:200-216).

endpoints.name: swift_permissions
endpoints.purpose: Role check during page bootstrap. NOT needed for read-only data pulls.

endpoints.name: swift_config
endpoints.purpose: Shared config registry. Used to fetch LMDE_CARRIER_MASTER (carrier enum source).

endpoints.name: gateway_userdetails
endpoints.purpose: User record bootstrap. Fires on every gscope page load — informational only.

endpoints.name: gateway_smc_promise
endpoints.purpose: Store metadata. Returns store record for pickupPointIds. Possible source for store_config regeneration.

endpoints.name: gateway_cms_custom_config
endpoints.purpose: Custom config. E.g. dispatcherUIEnvConfig exposes the swift.walmart.com path.

do_not_call_endpoints._purpose: Endpoints we probed that don't exist — they return SPA index.html as a 200 router fallback. Documented to prevent re-probing.
do_not_call_endpoints.detection_rule: If a gscope response is 200 OK with body length == 8281, treat as SPA fallback (NOT a real endpoint).
